label: Finding-60
title: amazon-honeypot: 2 smaller precision and sourcing points
description: 'from multiple actors' is stated as fact; Amazon says 'suggesting': Amazon: 'The actual payloads and choices in anonymization infrastructure varied, suggesting these were multiple actors.' Use 'probably from multiple actors'. | Only one capture of Amazon's post, 21 hours after its date: The post is dated 21 Oct with no time; the single capture is 11:17Z on 22 Oct. The Hacker News (captured 08:13Z) already reports 'broad exploitation in the wild', so the sentence existed by then, but whether it was in the first version cannot be shown.
